notes.title: Piece by Piece Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340549/3cb2113fc1357e5359e276331373e1d23c96d59b.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

The train has arrived, and we're super happy to announce that the [b]newest Piece by Piece demo is live![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468410/Piece_by_Piece_Demo/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340549/1d1d42b462296f3647b5a373ac57b60b9b866950.gif[/img]

We've been working hard behind-the-scenes to bring you this demo so we can give you an early sneak peek into Piece by Piece, and to show you just some of the cool things you can expect from the game!

You'll be able to do a bunch in this demo, including fixing different items, cleaning antiques, meet charming new characters (including the Mayor!) & chop wood to keep the oven warm! Keep an eye out for a very business acquainted mouse - he's always looking to strike a deal!

Join Grandpa while he shows you the ropes and inherit the family shop, so you can repair all the trinkets and heirlooms of your forest friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340549/9eb2f3267a544b57b9a8a8a05ee5a92490d389b6.gif[/img]

We hope you all have a blast with a demo! As we get closer to launch, keep an eye out for more updates in the meantime, there's plenty of exciting things to come!

notes.title: Thank YOU for Piece By Piece's big announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340549/a356389a1978bbb53ee3dc8e14aa6bfcef135ed7.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

We hope you all had a fantastic new year! We're super excited going into 2025, the year of Piece By Piece!

The response to Piece by Piece's announcement has been amazing, and we cannot wait to share more of the game with you, and eventually details on the launch date!

But what if we said you could play Piece by Piece before then? We'll be running playtests soon to give you hands on with the game before launch, so be sure to [url=https://piecebypiecegame.com/]click here[/url] and sign up so you can get playing the moment it drops! Everyone who signs up will be guaranteed a key, so you won't be missing out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340549/0926ae504c6e16dab91572e5b2663cf39178c834.gif[/img]

And of course, drop us a wishlist if you haven't already to keep up to date with news, updates & all things Piece by Piece! We'll see you very soon!

notes.title: Welcome to Piece By Piece!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340549/a356389a1978bbb53ee3dc8e14aa6bfcef135ed7.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

It’s time to open up shop - are you ready to get your hands dirty in Piece By Piece?

Away in the wonderful forest, you’ve taken over your Grandpa’s old shop, and it’s your job to keep the family business going! It’s up to you to fix your friends' antiques, heirlooms and precious trinkets, and send away some very happy customers! Keep in mind though, each item comes with a puzzle, some more complex than others, so roll up your sleeves and get repairing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340549/0926ae504c6e16dab91572e5b2663cf39178c834.gif[/img]

Repairing is not the only thing you’ll be getting your hands dirty with! You’ll get the chance to customize your inventory and splash it with colour, but for colour you need paint… maybe you could grow some berries in your back garden for some? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340549/d7bc57fb201d1e6037205c5a6e654c7442774c19.gif[/img]
Aside from your customers, you’ll need to maintain your shop too! Choose your own decor, furniture, and customize your shop to look exactly how you want it! Grab your broom and give it a clean when you’ve made a bit of a mess after repairing, and keep the fire going so you can bake some cookies while you work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340549/7eb35dff08d5772eb12b31f7c326f6d2a2299a17.gif[/img]

Want the chance to play early? You can sign up to try Piece by Piece early by [url=www.piecebypiecegame.com]clicking here[/url]!

You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/xqHhCQvmBQ]Discord[/url] to keep up to date with news, updates & more!

You’ll be able to get hands on next year, and we can’t wait to share more with you until then, bit by bit, Piece By Piece! 

Be sure to drop us a wishlist, and we’ll see you very soon!
